notes.title: How to apply the update DLC to “Re:light+” [WIN/Mac].
notes.notes:
You can also check the update manual at the following URL.

WIN
https://altercius.sakura.ne.jp/alterciws/Instructions/SEW/SEW.htm

MAC
https://altercius.sakura.ne.jp/alterciws/Instructions/SEM/SEM.htm

[h1]【Points to note when updating】[/h1]
Depending on your PC's specifications, it may take 20 to 30 minutes to complete the DLC update.
If you interrupt the update process,
you will need to uninstall the game and then reinstall it again. Please be careful.
Please allow yourself plenty of time to try this.
Save data from “Re:light” and “Re:light+” cannot be shared.
After upgrading to “Re:light+”, please overwrite the save data for “Re:light+”
without using the old save data.

[h2][b]【WIN版】[/b][/h2]
[h2]（1）[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184528/89d3c2c64bc24f2a80a90618ca4397da2e70c3ae.png[/img]
From the Steam launcher screen you have open,
please check that “Kaitou Tenshi TwinAngel Re:light” (“Re:light” )
is installed on your PC and that it starts up normally.
After checking, please be sure to close the game.

[h2]（2）[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184528/7cd8f8b20fb7c49f7735163fda2308af94bba888.png[/img]
Scroll down the screen and click on the words “Manage DLC (the asterisk indicates the number of items)” in the DLC section to open a separate screen showing the DLC you have purchased.

[h2]（3）[/h2]
Please check the box to the left of the item name of the DLC you have already purchased
from the list of DLC that has been downloaded.
The update will begin immediately after you check the box.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184528/2073b24e5c433fa728889c55ceebbe6ef86f8f6c.png[/img]
[b]【CAUTION】
Please do not perform any operations such as unchecking the checkboxes during the update.
This may cause the game data to be corrupted, preventing the update from being performed correctly.[/b]

[h2]（4）[/h2]
After confirming that the update is complete,
press the “Play” button to start the game, and
the words “Nowloading” will appear in the top left corner of the window
and the screen will go black with no image.
[b](This is not a malfunction.
Depending on the PC model, a white screen may appear before the black screen).[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184528/f34e42673b8490dd135b1eabba9bb8866bccbe2e.png[/img]
[b]【CAUTION】
Normally, it will take a few minutes to 20 minutes to move on to the next operation,
but this time may vary depending on the PC's machine specifications, so
please understand in advance.[/b]

[h2]（5）[/h2]
After waiting for a while, a small window will appear on the screen
and a message will appear asking you to restart.
Press the “Yes” button and wait.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184528/641f69eacc4808e319cf2ee7fb89ad97c2d7f5ce.png[/img]
[b]"【CAUTION】
Please do not click on the screen or close the window at this point.
If you do, the game data may not be updated correctly,
and you may need to reinstall the game."[/b]

[h2]（6）[/h2]
If you wait for a while, the game window will disappear, so
please press the “Play” button again from the Steam launcher to start the game.
If it starts up normally and the logo on the start screen is
“Re:light+”, the update was successful.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184528/1934fcb2ed7b778e36e513cbd685eb25c0c1e64f.png[/img]


[h2][b]【Mac版】[/b][/h2]
[h2]（1）[/h2]
From the Steam launcher screen you have open,
please check that “Kaitou Tenshi TwinAngel Re:light” (“Re:light” )
is installed on your PC and that it starts up normally.
After checking, please be sure to close the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184528/4fcd3641a300390f39a489775f9cc68b6b5fb383.png[/img]

[h2]（2）[/h2]
Scroll down the screen and click on the words “Manage DLC (the asterisk indicates the number of items)” in the DLC section
to open a separate screen showing the DLC you have purchased.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184528/7c5eb8917743d1bb8120806d4bfb682e38fb0510.png[/img]

[h2]（3）[/h2]
Please check the box to the left of the item name of the DLC you have already purchased
from the list of DLC that has been downloaded.
The update will begin immediately after you check the box.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184528/2073b24e5c433fa728889c55ceebbe6ef86f8f6c.png[/img]
[b]【CAUTION】
Please do not perform any operations such as unchecking the checkboxes during the update.
This may cause the game data to be corrupted, preventing the update from being performed correctly.[/b]

[h2]（4）[/h2]
After confirming that the update is complete,
press the “Play” button to start the game, and
the words “Nowloading” will appear in the top left corner of the window
and the screen will go black with no image.
[b](This is not a malfunction.
Depending on the PC model, a white screen may appear before the black screen).
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184528/8b02e95d628ca8397d685fd0c3302d94bb38c273.png[/img]
After that, a message will appear on the screen saying
“Please select the location of the game executable file (.app) to which the patch will be applied.”
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184528/d589947b9c8b2404939fc7a6a7c2c8dae3959be0.png[/img]
If you click the “OK” button here, you will be asked to locate the .app file, so
after confirming that the top folder is “TA Tokiseka Relight”,
click the “TwinAngel” icon and press “Open”.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184528/f4c80ca81720ceb22e64418ecf1242b773e59fbe.png[/img]

[h2]（4-2）If the top folder is not “TA Tokiseka Relight”[/h2]
You will need to locate the .app file. Select the main hard disk, and
click in the following order: “(e.g.) User => user => Library => Application Support => Steam => steamapps
=> common => TA Tokiseka Relight”, and then click on the “TwinAngel” icon
and press “Open”.
However, depending on the folder, there may be hidden folders that are not displayed
. In that case, press the “command” + “shift” + “.” keys to display the hidden folder.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184528/a87fdb4d4d4d082b065f2b51ed5cd6580cac154b.png[/img]
After that, the game data will be updated, so
please wait a moment without clicking on the screen or closing the window.
[b]【CAUTION】
Normally, it will take a few minutes to 20 minutes to move on to the next operation,
but this time may vary depending on the PC's machine specifications, so
please understand in advance.[/b]

[h2]（5）[/h2]
After waiting for a while, a small window will appear on the screen
and a message will appear asking you to restart.
Press the “Yes” button and wait.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184528/6095efaf277977a13df684054217bfd62f25670c.png[/img]
[b]【CAUTION】
Please do not click on the screen or close the window at this point.
If you do, the game data may not be updated correctly,
and you may need to reinstall the game.[/b]

[h2]（6）[/h2]
If you wait for a while, the game window will disappear, so
please press the “Play” button again from the Steam launcher to start the game.
If it starts up normally and the logo on the start screen is
“Re:light+”, the update was successful.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184528/4856b72e9149122a8e5f36f56c282d4feebcf00a.png[/img]



[h1]【If the update does not complete successfully】[/h1]
If the game does not start when you press the “Play” button, there is a possibility that the update did not go through correctly. In that case, we apologize for the inconvenience, but please
uninstall the game and then install the original version of “Re:light” before trying the update process again.
・If the game does not start up properly even after reinstalling, there is a possibility that some kind of problem occurred with the game data during the update process. In that case, we apologize for the inconvenience, but we would be grateful if you could contact us at the following email address.
Contact us at: tatwre_pr@alterciws.com


[h1]【Other】[/h1]
・The Mac version is not covered by the update operation support. Please understand.
・The use of the game software “Kaitou Tenshi Twin Angel Re:light” and DLC data
   for any purpose other than game play is strictly prohibited.

notes.title: Caution:Not a malfunction. The status of the black screen of the update by DLC.
notes.notes:
After purchasing the “Re:light+” DLC with voice acting, if you press the “Play” button to start the game after the data has been updated, the window will display “Nowloading” in small letters and the screen will remain black for a while.
(Depending on the model, the screen may be white and then black after a short time.)

However, this is a state in which data is being transferred to update to “Re:light+”, and [b]it is not a malfunction that has stopped the game from running. [/b]
If you wait for a while, a window and button will appear to prompt you to restart the game, so please press “Yes” (the button will change to a pink button when you move the cursor over it).

After pressing the button, wait a moment and the window will close automatically, then launch the game again from the Steam launcher.

[b]*Please do not close the window or click anywhere other than the designated area when this happens. There is a risk that the data transfer will not be performed correctly and the game data will be corrupted.
[/b]

Please refer to the following URL for the procedure to update the software.

[WIN]
https://altercius.sakura.ne.jp/alterciws/Instructions/SEW/SEW.htm

[Mac]
https://altercius.sakura.ne.jp/alterciws/Instructions/SEM/SEM.htm



We hope you enjoy the enhanced version of Kaitou Tenshi TwinAngel: Toki to Sekai no Meikyu Re:light+, which features the passionate performances of popular voice actors.

notes.title: Apology and Update Regarding Release Date
notes.notes:
Dear Supporters of the Kaitou Tenshi Twin Angel series,

Thank you for your continued support.

We have an important update regarding the release date of "Phantom Thief Angels: Twin Angel - Labyrinth of Time and World - Re:light".

We were proceeding with the necessary steps to release the game within December. However, we have yet to receive a response from Valve regarding the final review process, despite it taking longer than the standard timeframe. As such, we are currently unable to confirm the official release date.

We are currently inquiring about the status of the review process, and we will provide another update as soon as the official release date is finalized. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause to those who have been looking forward to the release.

The planned retail price in the US is $17.99.
To commemorate the crowdfunding campaign, we will be offering a 40% discount for the first two weeks after release, bringing the price down to $10.79.
*Please note that this discount period is independent of the Winter Sale.

We are doing everything we can to deliver "Phantom Thief Angels: Twin Angel - Labyrinth of Time and World - Re:light" to you as soon as possible. We appreciate your patience and understanding.

We apologize again for the inconvenience caused. Your continued support is greatly appreciated.
